effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent may trash 1 Digimon card in their hand. If they don't, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] While your opponent has no Digimon, this Digimon can't attack.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon, gain 1 memory.
